$comment: The neutral instrument. Identical for both arms, which is only possible because the brief mandates ids rather than classes — how each substrate styles #hero is its own business, but both must have one. Properties chosen because every substrate has to produce them somehow: they are what a browser resolves, not what anyone authored. Selectors are per page: a hook that belongs to content.html would otherwise read as missing on index.html, and the harness would report every second-screen hook as a hole in the first screen.
